title: Terminal waits for cold health and releases bounded cleanup
description: Use a prepared private farm, real Terminal hooks and one cheap-model validation run. Retain the consumed input and failed run for in-place diagnosis. Never target an operator pool or an original product run.

release-timeout.intent: Recover the timed-out release claim and preserve a successor through real RPC.

cold-health.intent: Keep Terminal stopped until health waiting, then restart its cold server.

terminal-dispatch.intent: Prepare Terminal, confirm dispatch, then release the owned worker.
